description: Erection of two storey rear side closet wing extension, installation of pneumatic lifting platform from second to fourth floor, extension to rear fourth floor mansard roof, installation of PV panels at roof level, replacement of drainpipes and hoppers, refurbishment and alterations to rear windows, installation of lightweight pergola in rear garden, installation of air conditioning unit and sunken plant room within rear garden area, refurbishment of front windows and replacement of single glazing with slimline double glazing, retention of existing glazing at third floor level and installation of secondary glazing, external refurbishment works including reinstatement of York stone entrance steps, replacement of floor tiles to first floor terrace, reconditioned entrance door and fanlight, reinstatement of cornice detailing, repainting of front fa‡ade, alterations to layout including plan form at second floor level and reinstatement of historic plan form at third floor level,  installation of acoustic insulation within flooring and replacement of floor finishes and joists, replacement of modern ventilation grille and installation of cooling in master suite and at fourth floor level, refurbishment of under-stair storage cupboard and balustrades, removal of service risers, removal of downlights and replacement with pendant lights or wall sconces, replacement of all internal bathrooms, refurbishment of mechanical and electrical services, and associated works
